semanticBoundary.graphOrder: RCL declares the ordered generic Tensor node list, inputs, dimensions and readback policy
semanticBoundary.tensorIdentity: storageIdentity plus deterministic valueRoot remains the canonical Tensor reference
semanticBoundary.trainingStep: repeated forward graph execution only; no reverse-mode gradient or optimizer semantics
semanticBoundary.operations: generic Tensor matmul, elementwise add and additive masked softmax
semanticBoundary.numeric: BF16 storage, FP32 arithmetic where defined, BF16 round-to-nearest-even output
semanticBoundary.providerRole: auxiliary OpenCL cl_mem allocation, kernel argument binding and ordered dispatch organ only

residency.finalReadback: required exactly once after the final step
residency.resourceLifetime: one output buffer per graph node, reused for every step and released before session close
residency.inputLifetime: resident Tensor inputs remain bound for the enclosing provider session
residency.outputResource: ephemeral device resource reused across bounded forward steps, not a canonical Tensor value

acceptance: RCL validates a bounded ordered graph of two through eight generic Tensor nodes
matmul nodes require rank-2 BF16 dimensions and add/masked-softmax nodes require equal-shape inputs
masked-softmax nodes require explicit additive maskMode and add nodes omit shared and maskMode
each graph node consumes resident Tensor references or a resource produced by an earlier node
every node output buffer is allocated once and reused across the bounded step count
intermediate outputs remain device-resident and no intermediate device-to-host readback is permitted
the final node performs exactly one explicit device-to-host readback after the final step
all graph output resources and resident Tensor inputs are released before session close
operation, resource order, shape, step count, readback and unavailable AMD OpenCL fail closed
